svg.title: Gaussian boson sampling: manuscript results and an unpublished implication
svg.desc: Uniform matrix-law hiding and normalization are results of the hiding manuscript. Stockmeyer counting is an established external tool. The purple box and dashed arrow mark the additional unpublished implication from an assumed efficient classical GBS sampler to estimation on supplied Gaussian-factor inputs; its proof is omitted. Local anticoncentration supplies the analytic additive-to-relative conversion. The lower complexity conclusions are conditional on that unpublished implication and matching average-case hardness.
